Kerbside 0.8.6 Trusted Connections

Guarded release objectives:
- preserve the 0.8.5 timetable/live-overlay/Forecast v4 architecture;
- accept authoritative station minimum-connection data only when explicitly supplied with provenance;
- keep conservative Kerbside topology minima as the honest default;
- distinguish connection-time provenance from live evidence on both trains;
- make a recovery service actionable with Use this backup;
- add on-device Journey Watch that follows an adopted recovery while Kerbside is open;
- pass existing unit, WebKit and Chromium regression gates before main.
